title: Woman Refuses To Leave Trump's House Until He Meets Her
description:
In a bizarre turn of events on June 7th, 2022, a woman claiming to be Trump's wife arrived at the Mar-a-Lago club. She was stopped by the Secret Service, but she continued to insist that she wanted to meet Trump since he was her husband. Here's what happened when the local police arrived and found her in her taxi, unwilling to leave. She was not willing to comply at all. The officers had no choice but to arrest the woman because of her uncooperative behavior. She tried to convince the officers that she was now ready to go back home, but it was too late. The woman repeatedly told the officers that she wanted to go back home. She was charged with resisting arrest.
